lines.en: I inch along, arching and stretching.
The leaf veins are roads; I follow them.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但我一直在吃。
lines.en: I move slowly, but I never stop eating.

lines.zh: 我爬过叶缘，差点掉下去。
lines.en: I crawl over the leaf edge, nearly falling.
The fuzz on the leaf prickles my feet.
I go around the eaten holes.
I move to the leaf's underside, cooler there.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边啃出缺口。
lines.en: I walk and chew a notch as I go.
My body is thicker than the leaf stem.
I shift over to the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我每挪一寸，都先确认叶子。
lines.en: Each inch I check the leaf first.

lines.zh: 丛林里的叶子，是我全部的路。
lines.en: In this jungle, leaves are my only road.

lines.zh: 我往上爬，找嫩一点的部分。
lines.en: I climb higher for the tender part.

lines.zh: 我的脚很多，走起来一波一波。
lines.en: Many feet; my walk comes in waves.
I turn back from the leaf tip.

lines.zh: 我拱到叶脉交叉处，停一下。
lines.en: I stop where the veins cross.

lines.zh: 我贴在一片叶子上，不动。
lines.en: I lie flat on a leaf, motionless.
I breathe in slow stretches.
Too full to move.
There is my silk on the leaf.
I listen to water moving in the veins.

lines.zh: 我在看下一片叶子有多远。
lines.en: I am judging how far the next leaf is.
The wind moves and the whole leaf sways.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像一枚小指环。
lines.en: I curl into a small ring.

lines.zh: 我听着树叶被咬的声音。
lines.en: I hear leaves being chewed.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤很薄，看得见里面。
lines.en: My skin is thin enough to see through.
I am scouting a place to cocoon.
The veins show; only a skeleton is left.
You are bigger than a whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只能看见你的脸。
lines.en: I look up and see only your face.
Is that a leaf in your hand?
I grip the leaf, afraid of falling.

lines.zh: 你把我连着叶子抬起来了。
lines.en: You lifted me with the leaf.
I will not bite you; I bite leaves.

lines.zh: 你的手指太滑，我扒不住。
lines.en: Your fingers are too smooth to grip.
Move away and I can keep eating.

lines.zh: 丛林里很闷，你也觉得吧。
lines.en: The jungle is close. You feel it too?
I shrink back behind the leaf edge.
I curl myself into a knot.
I spit out green fluid.
That broke my skin.
I shrink beside a vein.
The pain makes me writhe.
My silk line snapped.
I tremble segment by segment.
I cannot lift a single segment.

lines.zh: 叶子上有我的血，是绿的。
lines.en: My blood on the leaf is green.
Touch me again and I squeeze into the fold.
A leaf! A leaf!
Put me on it; I want the tender part.
I eat nothing but leaves.
A little lower and I can reach it.
I try one small bite.
The veins in this one are tough.
I smell green leaf.
Do not touch me with your fingers.
Just set it down; I will eat slowly.
A slice this thick lasts me half a day.
You touched me and I curled up.
I was nearly pushed off the leaf.
My silk line broke.
That knocked a segment loose.
Do not press; I would burst.

lines.zh: 我贴在叶面上，抓得很紧。
lines.en: I cling to the leaf surface tightly.
The leaf flipped over from the bump.
I retreat toward the leaf stem.
You are too rough.
Again, and I fall off.
I am still only a larva.
That must wait until I have wings.
I see only the next leaf.
There are other larvae on this leaf.
Wait until I have cocooned.
That has nothing to do with me now.
I make no sound; I only chew.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子不够两只分。
lines.en: This leaf is not enough for two.
I need a higher branch.
Do not watch. I am shy.
I take the leaf stem in my mouth.
I cannot drag it.
I swallow this bit of leaf flesh.
A strand of my silk is wrapped on my feet.
I move it to the leaf's underside.
My jaws cannot get through it.
I push it with my mouth.
An egg — not mine.
I cover it with my body.
I look up. Who dropped it?
Something moves on the far side of the leaf.
I raise my head and shrink back.

lines.zh: 那东西有脚，我没有那么多。
lines.en: That thing has legs, but fewer than mine.
I move underneath the leaf to hide.
I spin silk, ready to drop.
Is it smaller than me?
I dare not move; I can only wait.
I dig every foot into the leaf.
The leaf sways too much to grip.
I roll myself up.
It is nearing the leaf edge.
I flatten myself against the leaf.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着那影子转。
lines.en: My eyes follow that shadow.
Each time it moves, the leaf shakes.
I do not dare lift my head.
I let my silk out longer.
It is searching for something on the leaf.
I retreat toward the stem.
It is getting closer.
I pull every segment tight.

lines.zh: 这片叶子没有别的地方躲。
lines.en: There is nowhere else on this leaf to hide.
One more retreat and I fall.
It stopped to sniff.
It stays, so I stay still.
I bit it. It did nothing.
I swing my head at it.
I have no teeth, only mandibles.
That only pushed it away.
I spit silk to tangle it.
When it touches me, I curl up.
I sink my jaws into its foot.
You have seen how little I have.
After the bite I crawl under the leaf.
I do not want to fight; I want to eat.
I come out of an egg.
My first mouthful is leaf.
I am tiny, only one segment.
I stir on the leaf surface.
Everything around me is green.
The jungle tastes wet.
I chew my first little hole.
I am a ring thicker than yesterday.
I spin my first thread.
I grip this leaf beneath me.

lines.zh: 叶子先烧起来，然后是我。
lines.en: The leaf burns first, then me.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，砸在土上。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf onto the soil.

lines.zh: 水珠包住我，我透不过气。
lines.en: A drop of water surrounds me and I cannot breathe.
The blast blows me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过叶子，也穿过了我。
lines.en: Something passes through the leaf, and through me.
Something inside me is scrambled.

lines.zh: 没有叶子，我的身体在干。
lines.en: No leaves, and my body dries out.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我从叶上滚落。
lines.en: The thunder rolls me off the leaf.
No leaf below, only emptiness.
